data.body: [P2] Preserve the request until the first run hook arrives. The existing contract permits HTTP jobs before the run hook. If a suspendAfter job finishes before that hook starts, `runHooks` is empty and this code clears the pending request because no target exists yet. The later valid hook sets `suspendTarget`, but its recheck finds no request, leaving the VM running throughout the customer's wait despite acknowledging the option. Retain the request until the initial hook establishes whether a usable target exists, and cover job completion before hook arrival.
